title: Pixel art factory
description: A logo for the project, drawn with code (Pillow, SVG, shaders) on a virtual screen, only the provider; the GPU if given.
notes: The GPU, if given: dri (Intel/AMD, /dev/dri), rocm (AMD, /dev/kfd and /dev/dri) or nvidia (Podman with a CDI specification: sudo nvidia-ctk cdi generate --output=/etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml). A GPU weakens the isolation; the security modes high and paranoid refuse it.
prompt: Design a logo for this project, drawn only with code (Pillow, SVG or a shader): three variants in /work/logo/, each with the code that makes it, and a screenshot of them side by side.
